scholarships.title: Fulbright Program (Poland-US)
scholarships.degree: Graduate, PhD, Postdoctoral, Teaching, Research, Professional

existing.description: Jeffrey Hanafie. Student from Indonesia studying robotics in Warsaw, scholar of Łukasiewicz Programme.
eligibility: Highly qualified US citizens for study/research/teaching in Poland; highly qualified Polish citizens for study/research/teaching in the US; all degree levels and fields
existing.notes: One of the most prestigious exchange programs. Administered jointly since 1959. Separate application processes for US and Polish citizens. Detailed US-citizen info: https://fulbright.edu.pl/en/category/grants/for-american-citizens/ and https://eca.state.gov/fulbright/country/poland
existing.duration: Academic year (9–10 months); flexible for shorter terms
